# CANDIDATE: GAP_FADE_WITH_OPENING_RANGE_FAILURE_AND_VOLUME_DRY_UP

**Filed:** 2026-09-11  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

After a gap up, failure to hold above opening range high on declining volume indicates weak buying and fading opportunity. This strategy captures fade momentum by entering short when the gap up fails to sustain, ORH breaks on low volume, and bearish EMA alignment confirms downward bias.

## Mechanism

Entry: Gap up (open > prior day close by > 0.25%), price fails to hold above opening range high (ORH) for two consecutive 5-minute closes with volume < 0.7 * average volume of prior 20 candles (volume dry up), and EMA(9) < EMA(20) < EMA(50) (bearish ribbon). Exit: Stop at ORH or 0.4*ATR above entry, target at 1.2:1 reward-risk, trail runner with 8% of ATR from high-water mark using premium-stop after 0.5R profit. Regime filters: VIX > 24, time between 9:35-10:20 AM ET, excludes gaps <0.15% or >1.0%.
